research.caveats:
Method: browser pane denied navigation to suggestqueries.google.com, www.google.com/complete and duckduckgo.com/ac (all 'denied or failed'), so autocomplete (AC) was read by same-origin fetch of google.ch/complete/search?client=firefox&hl=en&gl=ch from my own tab on a google.ch SERP; SERPs read via navigate+get_page_text on google.ch (hl=en, gl=ch). No consent wall or CAPTCHA appeared. All AC seeds, the a-z expansion (26 letters x 4 head seeds) and about 65 extra shortened/variant seeds were run; 6 seeds returned empty AC (mercedes v class chauffeur switzerland, airport transfer switzerland fixed price, swiss chauffeur hourly hire, wedding car hire zurich, luxury car with driver switzerland, v class chauffeur switzerland), so shortened variants were used and flagged in evidence. 25 SERPs read (the 19 seeds minus those not needed, plus 6 extras: zurich airport to bern transfer, zurich airport to basel private transfer, zurich chauffeur service, private chauffeur zurich, zurich airport limousine service, geneva airport to zurich transfer); the 'zurich to davos/st moritz/zermatt/interlaken/lucerne/basel/geneva' SERPs show localisation to Zurich/Rümlang.
Scores are proxies, not search volumes: volumeProxy = 5 when the phrase is the top-ranked AC for a short head seed and also in related searches, 4 AC in the top 5 or AC across several seeds, 3 AC or related once, 2 a-z only or title-only, 1 long seed only. difficulty comes from the SERP composition for the SERPs read; where the keyword's own SERP was not read it is inferred from the nearest read SERP and says 'SERP not read' in evidence. Several AC lists are polluted by job-seeker ('Chauffeur Kat B', 'jobs'), insurance (Zurich Insurance), transit/connecting-flight and train queries; these were excluded except a few informational ones kept for journal topics.
Key observations: (1) z-als.ch already ranks #2 organic for 'zurich airport limousine service' with the title 'Zurich Airport Limousine Service'. (2) 'chauffeur zurich' SERP is shared with job boards; the commercial intent is better served by 'zurich chauffeur service', 'private chauffeur zurich', 'executive/corporate chauffeur zurich'. (3) Long-route queries (St Moritz, Zermatt, Interlaken, Davos, Lucerne, Basel, Bern) are dominated by transfer aggregators, rail/Trainline/Rome2Rio and Facebook threads; only Blacklane (St Moritz) and Sixt ride (Zurich limousine, ZRH, Basel) appeared as giant brands; Blacklane also appears on 'swiss chauffeur hourly hire'. (4) Query-wide PAA 'What is cheaper in Zurich, taxi or Uber?' appeared on 12+ SERPs, plus several 'Can I use Uber...' questions: a taxi/Uber vs fixed-fare chauffeur FAQ/journal article has clear demand. (5) Competitor title patterns: price-in-title/snippet ('From CHF 110', 'from CHF 89', 'from CHF 81', Driveguard 'from CHF 107/109/119', SWIVON 'CHF 90/100/120 per hour'); 'Fixed Price/Fixed-Price Private Transfers' (Grandlane, zurichairporttransfer.ch); 'Zurich to X Transfers – Affordable & Hassle-Free' (Alps2Alps); 'Zurich airport to X Private Transfer | N hours, Fixed Price' (AlpinBus); 'Transfer Zurich ⇄ Interlaken' (SWIVON); 'Limousine Service Zürich | Premium Chauffeur & Fixpreise' (swissfirstlimousine.ch); 'First Class Chauffeur Zurich | Airport Transfers & Private Driver' (Swiss Top Transfer); 'Zurich to St Moritz Transfer - Private, Chauffeured Rides' (Blacklane). (6) Observed competitor 'from' prices (vehicle-class minima) for comparison with z-als fixed fares: Davos from CHF 540 (zurichairporttransfers-ch.com), Lucerne from CHF 202-245 (SwissASAP, Swiss Top Transfer), Interlaken from CHF 408-410 (SwissASAP, DriveCab), Basel CHF 310 (Switzerland Car Service) and EUR 305-550 (GetByTransfer), St Moritz from CHF 814 (Grandlane) and ~CHF 600 taxi (Blacklane), Zermatt EUR 747.50-1,467.40 (GetByTransfer), Geneva-Zurich from CHF 963 (Swiss Limo), hourly CHF 90-130 (SWIVON, Driveguard, Leaders Limousines); z-als published fares (Davos 960, Basel 540, Luzern 408, Interlaken 990) are roughly 1.7-2.4x those 'from' prices where they overlap. (7) Geneva queries are dominated by French-side ski-transfer operators (Chamonix, Morzine, Val Thorens) and rail content; low relevance for a Zurich-based fleet. (8) Search results show AI Overview on the Basel query; not on others.

Many long seeds returned no suggestion; they are marked volumeProxy 1 in keywords. SERPs: 21 read in full (get_page_text, google.ch, hl=de, gl=ch, no sign-in, no ads clicked, no consent wall or CAPTCHA on SERPs). Difficulty for keywords without their own SERP is inferred from the nearest SERP and says so in the evidence. volumeProxy is autocomplete rank and related-search presence only, not real search volume. Intent warnings: 'chauffeur' and 'privatchauffeur' head terms are polluted by job intent (Indeed, jobs.ch, 'jobs', 'gesucht', 'für reiche' variants); 'limousine mieten' and 'limousine mit fahrer' skew to stretch, Hummer and party limousines and to wedding oldtimers, which the fleet (E-, S-, V-Class, SUV, bus) does not match; 'zürich flughafen davos / st moritz / zermatt / interlaken' suggestions are mostly train-timetable queries. I left stretch, oldtimer, job and Emirates-brand suggestions out of the keyword list. Title patterns competitors use: 'Flughafentransfer <Stadt> mit SIXT ride'; 'Transfer von Zürich nach <Ziel> | Festpreis ab CHF <x>' (airporttaxizrh.com: Davos not shown, St. Moritz 650, Zermatt 700, Interlaken 380, Luzern 220); 'Transfer Zürich ⇄ <Ziel>' (SWIVON); 'Limousine Service Zürich | Premium Chauffeur & Fixpreise'; 'Chauffeur Stundenbasis Zürich: Pro Stunde fix buchen'; 'Hochzeitsauto mit Chauffeur ab CHF 180'; English 'Zurich to <Ziel> Transfers – Affordable & Hassle-Free' (Alps2Alps). Observed competitor prices for pricing and FAQ context: St. Moritz from CHF 650 and Zermatt CHF 635-700 (airporttaxi24.ch, airporttaxizrh.com), Interlaken from CHF 380, Luzern CHF 220-260, hourly chauffeur CHF 90/h (SWIVON), V-Class CHF 300 first hour then 140/h (stretch.ch), airport taxi to Zürich centre about CHF 65 (airport page), per-km tariffs CHF 3.3-6.0 (vip-vantransfer.com, swissairportzurich.taxi). The client's listed fixed fares (Davos 960, St. Moritz 1290, Zermatt 1500) are well above these quoted figures, so 'festpreis'/'ab CHF' price-led titles on those route pages would invite direct comparison. research.caveats: Method: google.ch hit a Google 'unusual traffic' CAPTCHA wall on the first request; I did not try to solve or bypass it and switched once to google.com with gl=ch&hl=it, which worked without a wall for all following SERPs (20 read). Navigating to suggestqueries.google.com was refused by the browser tool, so autocomplete was read from the same JSON endpoint on google.com (/complete/search?client=firefox&hl=it&gl=ch) via a same-origin fetch in my own tab; this is the same data. Italian autocomplete for Swiss transfer terms is very sparse: of the 19 seeds only 5 returned anything (autista privato svizzera, autista privato lugano, transfer aeroporto basilea, plus echoes), and the 104-query a-z expansion of the 4 head seeds produced suggestions only for 'autista privato svizzera' (all job-seeker phrasing); a-z for 'transfer aeroporto zurigo', 'noleggio auto con autista svizzera' and 'transfer aeroporto zurigo prezzo' returned nothing. I therefore added shorter probe seeds (transfer zurigo, taxi zurigo, transfer lugano, transfer basilea, transfer st moritz/zermatt/davos/interlaken, da zurigo a X, noleggio auto con autista, ncc ..., aeroporto zurigo ...); these probes are where most volumeProxy 3-4 values come from. volumeProxy is therefore a within-IT relative signal only (nothing reached 5), not search volume. difficulty is observed for the ~20 SERPs read; where the evidence says 'SERP not read' the difficulty is an estimate from analogous SERPs. Ads: no ad blocks or 'Annuncio/Sponsorizzato' labels appeared in the extracted page text of any SERP, but get_page_text may omit them; treat as unconfirmed. Local 3-pack appeared for transfer aeroporto zurigo, autista privato zurigo, taxi aeroporto zurigo prezzo and transfer aeroporto svizzera prezzo fisso. Aggregators (Transfeero, Alps2Alps, Tripadvisor, Viator, GetYourGuide, Blacklane, Rome2Rio, GetTransfer, Swiss Activities, Grandlane) dominate route queries (Davos, St. Moritz, Zermatt, Interlaken, Lucerne); Blacklane/Viator/GYG only on St. Moritz. Italian-language Swiss specialists with Italian titles seen: SWIVON (swivon.ch, titles 'Servizio autista Zurigo', 'Servizio limousine Zurigo', 'Trasferimento Zurigo <-> Davos/St. Moritz/Interlaken'), Rentava, Grandlane, airporttaxi24.ch (per-town 'Prezzo taxi aeroporto Zurigo X' pages), zuerichairporttaxi.ch ('Taxi Aeroporto Zurigo Prezzo Fisso'), Limousinehire.ch, hop-in.ch, Transfer Baltici. Ticino/Lugano queries (autista privato Lugano/Ticino, NCC Lugano, noleggio con conducente Ticino, wedding cars) are served by small local sites (difficulty 2). SOURCE CAVEAT: Google (google.ch and google.com) returned the 'unusual traffic' CAPTCHA wall in this browser; per instructions I did not try to solve or bypass it. Organic positions below come from DuckDuckGo html (html.duckduckgo.com, kl=ch-en/de/fr/it), ads excluded (Transfeero and Klook bought the ad slot on 5 of the 6 queries; not on the Davos query). Ranks are therefore DDG ranks, not Google ranks; on-page data was read directly from each page with javascript_tool (document.title, meta description, h1/h2, JSON-LD @type walk, innerText word count, regex for CHF/EUR figures). 29 rows: 28 pages opened (ProntoPro returned 403, so only its SERP snippet is recorded). Rows not opened but seen in SERPs: citylane.ch/flughafentransfer-schweiz 'Flughafentransfer Schweiz ab CHF 60 | Citylane'; flughafendirekt.ch 'Flughafentransfer Zürich zum Festpreis | Flughafendirekt'; swissfirstlimousine.ch 'Flughafentransfer Zürich - 24/7 zuverlässig & pünktlich'; helvetiaride.com/fr 'Transfert Aéroport Zurich | Service Chauffeur Suisse | HelvetiaRide'; swissride-sarl.ch/fr; triptransfer.ch (Zurich-Davos, 150 km ~2.5 h); alpinbus; transferhood.

WHO RANKS: (1) Aggregators/marketplaces dominate the generic airport queries: Shuttle Direct (EN #2, DE #1, IT #2), Transfeero (FR #1, IT #1, plus paid ads), Blacklane (DE chauffeurservice #3), ProntoPro (DE chauffeurservice #1), Alps2Alps/Daytrip/Rome2rio (Davos). (2) The airport authority ranks #1 EN on a page about connecting flights (intent mismatch), so the EN head term is not locked. (3) Small Swiss operators do rank: Swiss2Alps, ZurichPickup, Zuerich Airport Taxi, airportzurichtransfers.ch, TransferB, Lucare, PMG, Swivon, Swiss Elite Transfers. A thin 129-word brand page (airporttaxi.ch) holds DE #4 and Blacklane holds DE chauffeurservice #3 with ~500 words and no FAQ, so page-1 slots are winnable with a better structured page.

TITLE FORMULAS OBSERVED (what each page optimises its title for): (a) '[Head keyword] [Place] | Brand' is the base: 'Zurich Airport Transfer & Private Taxi | ZurichPickup', 'Transferts Aéroport Zurich ZRH | Transfeero', 'Chauffeurservice in Zürich | Blacklane', 'Limousinen- und Chauffeurservice Zürich | PMG Limousine'. (b) Two head terms joined with '&' or 'und' to capture both: 'Airport & Taxi Transfer', 'Flughafen Zürich Taxi & Chauffeurservice', 'Limousinen- und Chauffeurservice', 'Taxis & transferts aéroportuaires', 'Train, taxi ou privé'. 'Taxi' is co-optimised in 6 of the 12 airport-query local titles. (c) Qualifier in title: 'mit Festpreis' (Lucare), 'Fixed Price' + '2 hours' (AlpinBus), 'Günstige' (airportzurichtransfers), 'con prezzo fisso' (TransferB separate URL), 'Privatfahrer & Tagesbuchung' (BlackLimousines). (d) PRICE IN TITLE/META is rare and effective on route queries: 'from CHF 515' (Swiss Elite Transfers), 'From €76 / £64 per person' (Alps2Alps H1+meta), 'ab CHF 60' (Citylane, SERP snippet), 'Ab 120 € pro Stunde' (BlackLimousines meta). Only 2 of 28 titles carry a price. (e) Meta-description trust stack repeated almost everywhere: fixed price / Festpreis / prix fixe / prezzo fisso, flight tracking (Flugverfolgung / suivi de vol / tracciamento volo), 24/7, meet & greet, free cancellation, child seats; rating in meta only on toptransfer ('★4.9 (214 reviews)'). (f) Over-long machine titles (Shuttle Direct DE ~118 chars, IT ~125 chars) and truncated ones (Noble IT: 'Servizio con autista e') are weak and still rank on authority.

H1 AND SECTIONS: H1 mirrors the query head term almost verbatim (e.g. 'Transfer Aeroporto di Zurigo (ZRH)', 'Flughafen Zürich Taxi', 'Zurich Airport to Davos Transfer'); Lucare's brand-promise H1 ('Ihr Chauffeur in Zürich. Immer derselbe.') works only because the title carries the keyword. Recurring H2 blocks on winners: how it works / book in 3 steps; fleet or vehicle classes; popular destinations/routes (internal link hub); 'what does it cost' or 'prices by vehicle class'; meet & greet + flight tracking + waiting time; child seats; reviews; FAQ. Davos route pages add distance and duration (150-154 km, ~2 h), pick-up both ways (Davos to Zurich), winter/summer, skis and luggage, WEF, and a 'private vs taxi vs shuttle vs train' comparison. Depth: winners 900 to 2,500 words (Transfeero 1.9-2.0k, Alps2Alps 2.5k, AlpinBus 1.9k, zrhairport.ch 1.7k, Swivon 1.6k, PMG 1.6k); smallest ranking local pages 740-930 words.

FAQ AND SCHEMA: 14 of 28 opened pages carry FAQPage JSON-LD; two more (airportzurichtransfers.ch with 12 Q-as-H2, PMG with 5 Q) show an FAQ but no schema. Typical local FAQ is 5-8 questions: how far ahead to book, fixed or metered price, what if my flight is delayed, how many people/suitcases, pay by card/invoice, child seats, where do I meet the chauffeur, cancellation, do you drive abroad; route pages: cost, duration/distance, meet & greet at ZRH, skis/luggage, Davos to Zurich return, WEF availability. Schema stack of best local pages: Organization/LocalBusiness (+TaxiService or LimousineService) + Service + Offer/AggregateOffer + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList (+AggregateRating/Review on aggregators and toptransfer). Without any JSON-LD: airportzurichtransfers.ch (DE #2), airporttaxi.ch (DE #4), the airport authority page. hreflang is common (Shuttle Direct 14 langs, Transfeero 5, Zuerich Airport Taxi 14, Swivon 12 incl. de-CH, toptransfer en-US/de-CH/fr-FR/it-IT, TransferB de/en/fr/it folders).

PRICE DISPLAY: about half show numbers in page text (13 of 28). Aggregators hide prices behind a booking widget (Shuttle Direct, Blacklane, Swiss2Alps) or show EUR lists (Transfeero EUR 39.75 to 278.30). Local winners with CHF text prices: airportzurichtransfers.ch (route table CHF 80 to 846), PMG (route table CHF 312.5 to 705), Swivon (CHF 610 + by class), Swiss Elite (CHF 515/620/700 by class), zrhairport.ch (CHF 120 flat), Lucare (CHF 120/140 and 5.50 figures). ZRH to Davos benchmarks seen: Swiss Elite from CHF 515, Swivon CHF 610, Alps2Alps EUR 76 per person (shared), Daytrip $69, public transport $31-52 (Rome2rio). z-als lists Davos at CHF 960, i.e. roughly 57% to 86% above the two local fixed prices, so a route page must justify it (class, S-Class/V-Class, door-to-door, waiting time) and show per-class numbers rather than a single high figure.

LANGUAGE: aggregator FR/IT/DE pages are machine-translated templates (Shuttle Direct DE 'Tolle niedrigst Preise'; Transfeero leaves 'Switzerland' and 'Aéroport de Zurich (ZRH)' in odd grammar; Noble IT has a cut-off title and an English H2). Italian queries use the exonym 'Zurigo' ('transfer aeroporto Zurigo', 'prezzo fisso'); no Swiss-Italian chauffeur company appeared in the IT top 6, and the IT/FR SERPs were led by Transfeero/Shuttle Direct/TransferB, so FR and IT are the lowest-difficulty places to win with native-quality pages. Some DE pages spell 'Zuerich' (title of zuerichairporttaxi.ch) while the content uses 'Zürich'; both forms are indexed.

WHAT A SMALL LOCAL COMPANY (z-als.ch) COULD DO BETTER, CONCRETELY: 1) Titles: '[Head term] [Place] ab CHF [floor] | Z-ALS' on home/services (airport query: 'Flughafentransfer Zürich – Festpreis ab CHF 120 | Z-ALS'; FR 'Transfert aéroport Zurich – prix fixe dès CHF 120'; IT 'Transfer aeroporto Zurigo – prezzo fisso da CHF 120'); route pages '[Origin] – [Destination] Transfer ab CHF X | 2 h | Z-ALS' (Swiss Elite and AlpinBus pattern). Keep under about 60 characters, unlike Shuttle Direct. 2) One dedicated page per route (Davos, St. Moritz, Zermatt, Basel, Bern, Luzern, Interlaken) of 900-1,600 words using the Swivon/AlpinBus skeleton: price per class table (E/S/V/SUV) as plain HTML text, distance and duration facts, pick-up both ways, winter/skis/luggage, WEF note, 5-6 route-specific FAQs. 3) Show the fixed fare as text in the page and the meta description (competitors' widgets and EUR lists leave this open), and add the hourly rate to the chauffeur page title/meta (only BlackLimousines does: 'ab 120 € pro Stunde'). 4) Schema: Organization + LocalBusiness/TaxiService, Service with Offer (priceCurrency CHF, per route), FAQPage matching the visible FAQ, BreadcrumbList, hreflang across the 4 locales with de-CH; add AggregateRating/Review only if real reviews exist (toptransfer shows 214 reviews at 4.9 in meta). 5) Native-quality DE-CH/FR/IT copy (no template translation) with local terms: 'Flughafentransfer', 'Chauffeurservice', 'Limousinenservice', 'transfert aéroport', 'transfer aeroporto Zurigo', 'prezzo fisso', 'Festpreis'. 6) Visible FAQ of 6-12 questions that match the queries: cost ZRH to city, flight delay, luggage/skis, cancellation, pay by card or invoice, child seats, where the chauffeur meets you, return trip, abroad. 7) Informational hub article in the zrhairport.ch style ('train 9-13 min vs private transfer, honest answer') to catch comparison queries and link to the booking page. 8) Trust phrases to carry on every page: Swiss-licensed, own fleet/same chauffeur (Lucare's 'Immer derselbe'), flight tracking, meet & greet, free waiting time, 24/7, free cancellation window. 9) Avoid weaknesses seen on competitors: no H1 (airportzurichtransfers.ch), truncated titles/metas (Noble IT), seasonal stale banners (Alps2Alps), visible FAQ without FAQPage schema (PMG), English fragments on localized pages.

cannibalisationRisks: Home /  (zurich airport transfer) vs /en/services (zurich chauffeur service): airport head term goes to the home page, the chauffeur/limousine/corporate/hourly cluster goes to services; the home keeps 'limousine service' only in its title and secondary keywords to protect the existing #2 ranking for 'zurich airport limousine service'.

Home (zurich airport transfer) vs /en/contact (book airport transfer zurich) vs /en/journal (zurich airport transfer guide): the three are separated by intent (commercial head term, transactional booking and Kloten, informational guides). Same pattern in DE, FR and IT with 'Ratgeber/Guide/Guida' and 'buchen/réserver/prenota'.
Services (zurich chauffeur service) vs About (switzerland chauffeur service): city-level service term versus national brand term; About stays a company page and must not repeat the services copy.

Home airport transfer vs route pages (zurich to davos transfer etc.): the home never lists per-route price keywords; route pages never use 'zurich airport transfer' as a title head. Basel (zurich airport to basel private transfer) also carries 'basel airport transfer' only as a secondary on the route page, never on the home.

Journal article 'what-a-fixed-fare-has-to-cover' (fixed price airport taxi) vs the home's 'airport transfer switzerland fixed price': the informational taxi-comparison phrasing is kept on the article, the commercial phrasing on the home.

Fleet (mercedes v class chauffeur zurich) vs Services (private chauffeur zurich): fleet gets vehicle-model terms only; 'hire' phrasing for self-drive V-Class (v-klasse mieten) is intentionally not targeted.
Davos (zurich to davos transfer) vs a future 'WEF Davos' article: the seasonal WEF phrasing stays a secondary keyword on the route page until a dedicated article exists.

FR/IT homes vs EN: FR and IT users often type English route queries; those English phrasings are secondary keywords on FR/IT route pages only if the page copy is in FR/IT, and are never assigned to a separate URL.
Zermatt/Interlaken/Lucerne route pages vs 'train' informational queries: train and timetable queries (Trainline, SBB) are deliberately excluded to avoid ranking for the wrong intent.

'chauffeur zurich' and 'privatchauffeur' head terms are job-board polluted, so they are served by services pages through 'zurich chauffeur service' and 'chauffeurservice zürich' rather than their own pages.
plan.titleFormulas: "Board homes: '{head airport-transfer keyword} [& secondary term | fixed-fare hook] | Z-ALS' (EN keeps '& Limousine Service' to retain the existing #2 ranking; DE/FR carry 'Festpreis ab / Prix fixe dès CHF 120'; IT drops the number to stay under 58 characters). Services and Fleet: '{keyword} | {audience or Fleet} | Z-ALS'. Contact: '{booking keyword with Kloten} | Contact | Z-ALS'. About and Journal: '{national or guide keyword} | About Z-ALS or Journal | Z-ALS'. Routes: '{Zurich to X Transfer} | Private Chauffeur | Z-ALS' (DE 'Privat mit Chauffeur', FR/IT 'Chauffeur privé' or 'Autista privato'), dropping 'Private Chauffeur' for 'Chauffeur' when the keyword is long. Titles are 58 characters or fewer; descriptions are 125 to 155 characters, lead with the service, give one concrete fact (distance, Täsch shuttle, Gotthard) and end on the fixed-fare promise. No prices in route titles because competitor 'from' prices (CHF 81 to 650) undercut Z-ALS fares. No flight-tracking, meet-and-greet or review claims."
plan.gaps: "Opportunities competitors miss: (1) Taxi vs Uber vs fixed-fare chauffeur: 'What is cheaper in Zurich, taxi or Uber?' appears as PAA on 12+ SERPs and 'Can Uber pick up at Zurich Airport?' in EN, DE, FR and IT, yet no private operator answers it; write one honest comparison article per language and link it from the home and journal. (2) Distance and travel-time pages ('how far is Davos from Zurich', 'da zurigo a lugano') have demand but only rail and tourism sites answer; fold a short facts block into each route page and consider one article. (3) Seasonal WEF Davos (January) and ski transfers: a section on the Davos page covering ski equipment and winter road conditions; the existing 'winter-routes' article can link into it. (4) Kloten local intent: 'chauffeur kloten', 'limousine service kloten' and 'airport taxi zurich kloten' show geo demand with only a few small operators; add address, opening hours and LocalBusiness schema, and claim a Google Business Profile for Kloten. (5) Zermatt honesty: most competitors skip that cars stop at Täsch; saying so is a trust signal. (6) Price positioning: Z-ALS published fares (Davos 960, St. Moritz 1290, Zermatt 1500, Interlaken 990, Basel 540, Luzern 408) are roughly 1.7 to 2.4 times competitor 'from' prices, so compete on a single-vehicle fare, no meter, 24/7 dispatch and Swiss licensing rather than on price in titles. (7) Austrian cross-border (St. Anton, Lech, Vorarlberg) is searched in DE and EN with weak competition; quote by hand and say so. (8) FAQ schema with the eight questions per language on the home and contact pages. Limits and honesty notes: volumeProxy is autocomplete rank only, not search volume; entries marked derived (journal indexes, About, Contact FR/IT, Lugano EN/DE, Geneva FR/DE) were built from the nearest observed phrasing and need validation in Search Console. Job-intent noise (chauffeur jobs, salaries) dominates 'chauffeur', 'privatchauffeur', 'chauffeur privé suisse' and 'autista privato svizzera', so those heads are avoided. Wedding-car and stretch-limo terms (hochzeitsauto, voiture de mariage, limousine mieten) were excluded because the fleet is E-, S-, V-Class, SUV and bus. Geneva and EuroAirport local-airport queries are dominated by French-side operators and public transport and are not targeted. Flight tracking and meet-and-greet are not claimed anywhere; the FAQ question on flight delays should be answered only with what dispatch actually does. Existing pages under /en/journal/* beyond the two mapped are left unchanged. Route pages for FR/IT where evidence was thin (Interlaken, Lucerne, Bern, St. Anton) are omitted and can be added later at the same slug."
